subject: a slight, lively Austrian composer of the 1780s in his late twenties, with a pale face, large bright eyes and a light powdered wig tied back with a black ribbon, wearing a fine embroidered frock coat with lace cuffs, a waistcoat and knee breeches

panels.01-salzburg: the narrow old street of Getreidegasse in Salzburg in 1756 on a winter morning, tall pastel baroque townhouses with wrought-iron shop signs, a hilltop fortress and church domes beyond, townspeople in 18th-century cloaks, snow on the roofs, warm lamplight in an upper window, wide establishing shot
panels.02-empress: a small six-year-old boy in a tiny embroidered court suit and powdered wig seated at a harpsichord, playing with total concentration in a gilded baroque palace hall in Vienna in 1762, an empress in a wide silk gown and courtiers listening with delight, his father in a plain dark coat standing proudly nearby, his older sister waiting beside the instrument, chandeliers, warm candlelight
panels.03-grandtour: an 18th-century family travelling coach on a winding road along the river Rhine in 1763, a broken wheel being repaired by the coachman, a father in a tricorn hat directing, a young girl and a small boy in a wig looking out of the coach window with curiosity, a wooden keyboard case strapped on the roof, castles on the hills and vineyards, golden light, a sense of a long journey across Europe
panels.04-london: a small eight-year-old boy in an 18th-century coat sitting at a table in a modest London lodging in 1764, writing music notes with a quill on a large sheet of manuscript paper by candlelight, deep in thought, his older sister reading quietly by the window, Georgian brick houses and chimney smoke outside, ink pot and sheets of music on the table
panels.05-milan: a fourteen-year-old boy composer in a red embroidered coat and powdered wig seated at a harpsichord in the orchestra pit of a grand Italian opera house in Milan in 1770, leading a rehearsal with a raised hand, singers in baroque costume on a candlelit stage, musicians with violins and oboes watching him closely, tiers of gilded boxes
panels.06-figaro: {S} at a writing desk beside a fortepiano in a comfortable Vienna apartment in 1786, writing an opera score quickly with a quill, sheets of music spread across the desk and floor, a billiard table in the next room, a window onto a narrow old street near a cathedral spire, afternoon light, joyful concentration
panels.07-prague: {S} directing an opera from the keyboard in a candlelit 18th-century theatre in Prague in 1787, orchestra musicians around him, singers in costume on stage, a packed audience in tiers of boxes leaning forward, warm glowing footlights, energy and excitement
panels.08-lastyear: {S}, looking tired but focused, at a desk by candlelight in a Vienna room in late 1791, writing a large choral score with a quill, a few singers standing by the fortepiano trying out a passage from the pages, quiet, dignified and calm, winter darkness outside the window
